title: Monotonic slice
prompt:
Write `IsMonotonic(nums []int) bool`: true if `nums` is entirely non-decreasing or entirely non-increasing. One pass, O(1) memory.

`[1 2 2 3]` → `true`, `[1 3 2]` → `false`. Empty and single-element slices are monotonic.
hint: Track two flags, `inc` and `dec`, and clear one whenever you see a step the other way.
